title: エルコンドルパサー登場！

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No one knows…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No one knows my real face.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I'm weak. I'm a crybaby and a chicken… But…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ever since the day I put on this wrestling mask my papa gave me…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I became the world's strongest racer—El Condor Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um, we all know who you are…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, my Trainee Umamusume and I begin our Twinkle Series challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Except… she's not at the place we're supposed to meet. What's going on?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! What're ya looking at, Trainer? Up here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The voice is coming from… a treetop?! It's—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! Bursting with talent! Possessing the soul of a wrestler! Lover of all things spicy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aiming for the top of the world, soaring past the stars—it's your very own El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mornin', Trainer! I'm looking good today, right?
choice_data_list: You aren't overdoing it, are you?
You aren't overdoing it, are you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I know you'll just yell at me if I do.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But the minute you say "go," there's gonna be no stopping me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've got ambition higher than the Andes! La número uno en el mundo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa. No doubt she has the potential to one day be the world's strongest racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she still has a lot of room to grow, both physically and mentally. You can't soar high as a hatchling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to utilize her incredible sense of motivation and positivity to help her grow.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I've hit the ceiling and crashed every time I've started soaring.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But with you by my side, I know there's nothin' to be afraid of anymore!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? Rivals?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Now that you mention it, there are a ton of tough Umamusume in my class.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Take my roommate, Grass Wonder, for starters! She's a prodigy with a blue flame burning at the heart of her pure core!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why thank you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And then there's la nube, Seiun Sky! Like a cloud, she floats listlessly. But when push comes to shove, she moves in like an assassin!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I really don't, but sure!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's not forget the alluring King Halo! With an attitude loftier than the sky, she's a competitor who takes the fight outside the ring with her first-rate looks!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Alluring is right! What else do you expect of a first-rate racer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And last, but certainly not least, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …That's all I get?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: However, they aren't the ones whose name will soon be known the world over! Who is she?! Who could it be?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Trainer, I'm gonna ask you the same thing I asked you back when we started this tag team.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The world's strongest racer—she flies across the turf at light speed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And her name is?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's right! And now, we take our first step forward, spread our wings and take flight toward the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm not a weak little girl anymore! With our powers combined, let's take off and become the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's fly hella high! Higher than a condor! Higher than the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa shouts into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Coo, coo…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A condor takes flight overhead! …Well, a pigeon does.
